answer: Hide each answer's author from graders and flag graders whose marks drift from the crowd median in lockstep. A sybil ring pulling one thread of shared votes shows up as a tight cluster that bends together like a willow in wind, and its members forfeit grading pay for the epoch. To profit, an attacker must fund dozens of identities that each grade independently and well, which costs more than the reward, while an honest grader who scores a clumsy sonnet fairly loses nothing.
